'''Tom "Mountain" Murphy''' is an [[ally]].  He first appears in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game. He can be gained through an [[encounter]] at the [[Black Cave]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Fight]]

You take no [[Stamina]] loss from the [[Overwhelming]] ability.
